summary: Completed testing of 5 UI changes for Daleel SaaS platform. All features working correctly: (1) Theme toggle with localStorage persistence, (2) Date-day picker on My Products, (3) Fast product detail panel loading via aggregated endpoint, (4) Clickable product/storefront deep-links, (5) Per-store sparklines + full price-history chart in detail panel.
passed_tests: GET /api/health returns healthy status (mongodb connected, 13 scheduler jobs)
POST /api/auth/login works correctly with admin credentials (admin@daleelpets.com)
GET /api/auth/me returns user data with valid token
GET /api/my-products returns kpis + products (5000 products, 1.97M SAR revenue)
GET /api/my-products?days=7 filters to 7-day window (3306 products)
GET /api/my-products?on_date=YYYY-MM-DD filters to specific day
GET /api/my-products?date_from=X&date_to=Y filters to date range
GET /api/products/{sku}/full returns aggregated payload with product, store_prices[], history{}, velocity{}
GET /api/stores returns store list
GET /api/encryption/verify returns {status: 'active', ok: true}
Login flow redirects to / (My Products page) after successful auth
Theme toggle button (data-testid=theme-toggle-btn) toggles html[data-theme] between dark/light
Theme persists to localStorage (key: daleel_theme)
Theme toggle label changes between 'Light Mode' and 'Dark Mode'
Theme toggle icon swaps between Sun and Moon
Light theme: white background, light sidebar, light table rows, dark text - all readable
Inline script in index.html applies theme from localStorage before paint (no flash)
Date range buttons (7D/14D/30D/90D) work and update product list
Day picker input (data-testid=day-picker-input) accepts YYYY-MM-DD and filters products
Day picker clear button (data-testid=day-picker-clear) resets to days-based filter
Product row click opens ProductDetailPanel sheet (data-testid=product-detail-panel)
Detail panel loads via single GET /api/products/{sku}/full?days=30 endpoint
Detail panel shows per-store sparkline SVGs (data-testid=store-trend-{store_id}) with +/-% indicators
Detail panel shows Recharts LineChart price history when historyData has rows
Detail panel shows velocity bar chart with daily units
Product name links (data-testid=product-link-{sku}) open in new tab (target=_blank)
Store name links in detail panel (data-testid=store-link-{store_id}) link to product_url
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 UI changes verified working: (1) Theme toggle with Sun/Moon icons, localStorage persistence, and no-flash inline script in index.html; (2) Date picker with day-picker-input and day-picker-clear buttons; (3) Product detail panel loads via single /api/products/{sku}/full endpoint; (4) Product links with target=_blank; (5) Sparklines in detail panel with trend percentages and Recharts price history chart.

theme_toggle.details: Toggle button in sidebar, Sun/Moon icons, localStorage persistence (daleel_theme), inline script prevents flash on reload

date_day_picker.details: Date input accepts YYYY-MM-DD, calls /api/my-products?on_date=X, clear button resets to days filter

product_detail_panel.details: Single aggregated endpoint /api/products/{sku}/full returns product, store_prices, history, velocity in ~2s

deep_links.details: Product name links have target=_blank, store links in detail panel link to product_url

sparklines_and_charts.details: Per-store sparkline SVGs with +/-% trend indicators, Recharts LineChart for price history, bar chart for velocity
